cases.title: From actinomycete diversity to cell activity
cases.question: Which reported microbial sources connect to a compound with a traceable nanomolar cellular result?
cases.sampling: Red Sea coastal waters near Jeddah, Saudi Arabia; sampling depth not reported.
cases.scope_note: Related marine extension. This case does not establish deep-sea provenance. The ambiguous printed coordinates remain withheld.

results.locator: PDFp1/p2 compounds1/2; p3 MTT48h; p4 Table1 and Figure3 uncertainty
results.uncertainty_note: Reported ± retained; fitted IC50 uncertainty type is not separately defined

results.locator: PDFp1/p2 compounds1/2; p3 MTT48h; p4 Table1 and Figure3 uncertainty
results.uncertainty_note: Reported ± retained; fitted IC50 uncertainty type is not separately defined

steps.title: Select a biological group
steps.text: Choose Bacteria → Actinomycetes to see 37 source profiles and 115 distinct associated compounds. Narrowing to Streptomyces gives 21 profiles and 65 compounds.
steps.label: Open Actinomycetes

steps.title: Inspect the producer and collection context
steps.text: Open S. caelestis AW9-9C and inspect its Red Sea collection description, reported identification evidence and two associated products. Depth remains unknown.
steps.label: Open AW9-9C

steps.title: Resolve the compound and its own assay
steps.text: Follow citreamicins ε A and ε B to the HeLa experiments. Both values are from the same 48 h MTT study, with the original uncertainties retained.
steps.label: Open the HeLa assay

steps.title: Return to the primary publication
steps.text: Use Table 1 and Figure 3 on PDF p4 for the cellular results, p3 for the MTT procedure and p2 for microbial collection. The caspase/apoptosis findings are not a direct-binding assignment.
steps.label: Read the primary article

cases.conclusion: The source, chemical record and cellular experiment are connected through evidence. Cell viability and apoptosis do not identify a directly bound molecular target.

references.locator: PDF p2 collection; p3 methods; p4 Table 1 and Figure 3

cases.title: From a deep-sea sampling record to compound activity
cases.question: Can a cellular result be traced back to an explicitly reported deep-sea producing strain?
cases.sampling: South China Sea sediment collected at 1,400 m; numerical coordinates not reported.
cases.scope_note: Depth-qualified deep-sea source. Reported ITS accession PX069401 is an evidence-linked identifier, not a new authentication performed by the database.

results.uncertainty_note: Reported ± retained; fitted IC50 uncertainty type is not separately defined

steps.title: Start with sampling and identification
steps.text: Open RCDB005 to inspect the 1,400 m sediment source and reported accession PX069401. The profile connects 16 compound records. Identification details not stored in the profile remain unassigned; the primary article provides the ITS context.
steps.label: Open RCDB005

steps.title: Follow the reported product
steps.text: Select penicacid M, identified as compound 16 in the article, and inspect its chemical record and source-specific provenance.
steps.label: Open penicacid M

steps.title: Keep the assay conditions with the result
steps.text: The MOLM-13 result comes from a CCK-8 cellular assay after 72 h exposure, read at 450 nm after a further 2 h reagent incubation. The displayed nM value is an exact rescaling of the reported μM value.
steps.label: Open the MOLM-13 assay

steps.title: Check the original evidence chain
steps.text: Verify compound 16 and its activity in PDF p9 Table 4, the producing strain and 1,400 m sampling depth in p10 Section 3.2, and the assay in p13 Section 3.8.
steps.label: Read the primary article

cases.conclusion: This case supports a reported deep-sea origin and a measured cellular antiproliferative result. The article does not assign a molecular target to that result.

references.locator: PDF p9 Table 4; p10 Section 3.2; p13 Section 3.8

cases.title: From a target annotation to the actual experiment
cases.question: What was measured behind a target label, and which source context belongs to the compound?
cases.source_name: Marine-derived Streptomyces sp.; strain unspecified in the reviewed source article
cases.sampling: Marine-derived culture reported in a separate 2021 article; locality, water depth and coordinates not specified.
cases.scope_note: Related marine extension. The 2008 assay uses piericidin A1 as reference compound 5; it does not identify that test material as a product of the iromycin-producing Dra17 strain.

results.test: NADH oxidation in bovine-heart submitochondrial particles
results.normalization: molar value in the same primary table; no mass-to-molar inference
results.locator: p1741 Table1; p1742 reference inhibitor5; bovine heart SMP NADH oxidation
results.method: Not specified in the stored assay row

results.locator: PDF p5 cytotoxicity paragraph; full page plus legible result crop
results.method: Not specified in the stored assay row

steps.title: Enter through the target annotation
steps.text: Open Mitochondrial complex I; NADH oxidoreductase and follow the primary functional row for piericidin A1.
steps.label: Open the target record

steps.title: Inspect the tested preparation
steps.text: The measured preparation is bovine-heart submitochondrial particles, with NADH oxidation as the functional readout. It is not an isolated single-subunit binding experiment.
steps.label: Open the functional assay

steps.title: Separate function, cytotoxicity and origin
steps.text: The same 2008 paper reports L929 cytotoxicity separately. The stored marine-source report belongs to a different publication; its sampling gaps remain visible.
steps.label: Open the source context

steps.title: Verify the original records
steps.text: Check PDF p4 Table 1, p5 for the reference-compound and L929 descriptions, and p7 Sections 6.2–6.3 for the mitochondrial assay. The separate 2021 source report is Section 5.1.
steps.label: Read the assay article

cases.conclusion: Functional inhibition, cellular cytotoxicity and microbial origin retain separate publication contexts. No individual subunit, UniProt identifier or direct binding is inferred.

references.locator: PDF p4 Table 1; p5 biological results; p7 Sections 6.2–6.3
PDF p13 Section 5.1; separate marine-source report

unit_policy: Preserve original database units and values. nM is an explicitly labeled display rescaling of molar values; do not infer a molar value from mass concentration.
